Name: Bundle Display
Author: 0JOG
Description:
[size=4]When you a pickup an item that can be donated to a bundle in the community center, a message will show.

[/size][size=3]No more cross checking all the items in all the bundles manually to see if you can sell an obtained item.
I created the mod out of pure annoyance from the above mentioned problem.
The message will only show on items which are NOT yet donated.

This mod supports all of the languages available.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/18135/18135-1693667541-754232277.jpeg[/img]

[/size]

Feel free to let me know about bugs, suggestions etc.
I obtained most of the translations by ChatGPT and have no idea if most of them make any sense. If you want to have a translation corrected and can provide me with a translation, please let me know.

Future plans for this mod include the following at the moment:
﻿- [s]Show which bundle the item can be donated to[/s]
﻿- [s]Implement translations for all languages
[/s] ﻿- [s]Give players the option to only show the message once per item or every time[/s]
﻿- Detect items which are used in future/current quests
﻿- Edit the item tooltip to show this information there
